easy: Not correct all the time, so it can fool you.
ko: 믿을 수 없는, 신뢰할 수 없는

ex.en: My old watch is unreliable, so it shows the wrong time.
ex.ko: 내 낡은 시계는 믿을 수 없어서 시간이 틀리게 나온다.

easy: You cannot trust it to work well or to tell the truth.
ko: 믿을 수 없는, 신뢰할 수 없는

ex.en: The bus is unreliable, so we are late again.
ex.ko: 그 버스는 믿을 수 없어서 우리는 또 지각했다.

easy: Still good enough that you can use it.
ko: 사용할 수 있는, 쓸 수 있는

ex.en: These old crayons are still usable.
ex.ko: 이 오래된 크레용은 아직 쓸 수 있다.

easy: The food that comes up from your stomach and out of your mouth when you are sick.

ex.en: The sick puppy left vomit on the rug.
ex.ko: 아픈 강아지가 깔개에 토한 것을 남겼다.

easy: Rude and not polite in the way someone acts or talks.

ex.en: Burping loudly at the table is vulgar.
ex.ko: 식탁에서 크게 트림하는 것은 상스러운 행동이다.

easy: To pass things over and under each other so they join together.

ex.en: She wove flowers into a crown.
ex.ko: 그녀는 꽃을 엮어서 왕관을 만들었다.

easy: To make cloth by crossing threads over and under each other.

ex.en: Grandma weaves a warm blanket from wool.
ex.ko: 할머니는 양털로 따뜻한 담요를 짜신다.

easy: The wires inside a building that carry electricity.

ex.en: Dad checked the wiring behind the wall.
ex.ko: 아빠는 벽 뒤의 배선을 확인했다.

easy: The job of putting in the wires that bring electricity to a place.

ex.en: The wiring of our new house took two days.
ex.ko: 우리 새집의 배선 공사는 이틀이 걸렸다.

easy: A chemical your body makes that gives you quick energy when you are scared or excited.

ex.en: My adrenaline rushed when I stood at the top of the slide.
ex.ko: 미끄럼틀 꼭대기에 서자 아드레날린이 솟구쳤다.

easy: When nobody is in charge and there are no rules, so everything is out of control.

ex.en: When the teacher left, the classroom turned into anarchy.
ex.ko: 선생님이 나가시자 교실은 무질서 상태가 되었다.

easy: Toward the land from the water.

ex.en: The waves pushed the little boat ashore.
ex.ko: 파도가 작은 보트를 해안으로 밀어 올렸다.

easy: A very big room where people go to dance.

ex.en: They danced in a beautiful ballroom at the wedding.
ex.ko: 그들은 결혼식에서 아름다운 무도회장에서 춤을 췄다.

easy: A person who is new at something and still learning.

ex.en: I am a beginner at piano, so I play slowly.
ex.ko: 나는 피아노 초보자라서 천천히 친다.

easy: Using two languages.

ex.en: Our school has a bilingual class in English and Korean.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에는 영어와 한국어로 하는 이중 언어 수업이 있다.

easy: A person who can speak two languages very well.

ex.en: My mom is bilingual, so she speaks Korean and English.
ex.ko: 우리 엄마는 한국어와 영어를 둘 다 잘하는 이중 언어 사용자다.

easy: To love something very much and take good care of it.

ex.en: I cherish the letter my grandma sent me.
ex.ko: 나는 할머니가 보내 주신 편지를 소중히 여긴다.

easy: Living in a society that has schools, laws, and good knowledge.

ex.en: Ancient Egypt was a civilized land with cities and writing.
ex.ko: 고대 이집트는 도시와 문자를 가진 문명화된 나라였다.

easy: Polite and showing good manners and good taste.

ex.en: He is a civilized man who always says thank you.
ex.ko: 그는 항상 고맙다고 말하는 교양 있는 사람이다.

easy: A flat tool with thin teeth that you pull through your hair to make it neat.

ex.en: I use a comb to fix my messy hair.
ex.ko: 나는 빗으로 헝클어진 머리를 정리한다.

easy: The red, soft bump on top of a rooster's head.

ex.en: The rooster's red comb shook as he crowed.
ex.ko: 수탉이 울 때 빨간 볏이 흔들렸다.

easy: To hide something so that nobody can see it or know about it.

ex.en: She concealed the gift behind her back.
ex.ko: 그녀는 선물을 등 뒤에 숨겼다.

easy: Saying very strongly that something is bad or wrong.

ex.en: The whole town spoke out in condemnation of the bullying.
ex.ko: 온 마을이 괴롭힘을 비난하며 목소리를 높였다.

easy: A police car that drives around the streets to keep people safe.

ex.en: A police cruiser stopped at the red light.
ex.ko: 순찰차가 빨간불에 멈췄다.

easy: A big, fast ship that a navy uses.

ex.en: The navy cruiser sailed out to sea.
ex.ko: 해군 순양함이 바다로 나아갔다.

easy: To bend or twist into a round shape.

ex.en: Smoke curled up from the campfire.
ex.ko: 연기가 모닥불에서 구불구불 피어올랐다.

easy: To pull your body into a small, round shape.

ex.en: The cat curled up on my lap.
ex.ko: 고양이가 내 무릎 위에 웅크리고 누웠다.

easy: Knocked down and broken into pieces.

ex.en: The old school building was demolished last year.
ex.ko: 낡은 학교 건물은 작년에 철거되었다.

easy: To turn something off or make it stop working.

ex.en: Dad disabled the game on my tablet.
ex.ko: 아빠가 내 태블릿에서 게임을 못 쓰게 해 놓으셨다.

easy: Not honest; likely to lie or cheat.

ex.en: It is dishonest to copy answers from a friend.
ex.ko: 친구의 답을 베끼는 것은 정직하지 못한 일이다.

easy: Something that makes people think it may not be true or honest.

ex.en: His doubtful story about the missing cookies made Mom frown.
ex.ko: 없어진 쿠키에 대한 그의 의심스러운 이야기에 엄마는 얼굴을 찡그렸다.

easy: Not sure about something; thinking it might not work.

ex.en: I was doubtful that the thin branch could hold the swing.
ex.ko: 나는 가느다란 나뭇가지가 그네를 버틸 수 있을지 확신이 없었다.

easy: A big book or set of books with facts about many things.

ex.en: I looked up penguins in the encyclopedia.
ex.ko: 나는 백과사전에서 펭귄을 찾아보았다.

easy: Having letters or pictures cut into the surface.

ex.en: Her name is engraved on the silver cup.
ex.ko: 그녀의 이름이 은컵에 새겨져 있다.

easy: When a volcano suddenly shoots out hot rock, ash, and steam.

ex.en: The eruption sent ash high into the sky.
ex.ko: 화산 분출로 재가 하늘 높이 솟았다.

easy: A person who gives you a test to see what you know or can do.

ex.en: The examiner asked me to read the page out loud.
ex.ko: 시험관이 나에게 그 쪽을 소리 내어 읽어 보라고 했다.

easy: All the animals that live in one place.

ex.en: The fauna of Australia includes kangaroos and koalas.
ex.ko: 호주의 동물군에는 캥거루와 코알라가 있다.

easy: Staying loyal and true to someone you love or have promised to help.

ex.en: Dogs are known for their fidelity to their owners.
ex.ko: 개는 주인에 대한 충성심으로 잘 알려져 있다.

easy: In very small pieces.

ex.en: The chef finely chopped the carrots for the soup.
ex.ko: 요리사는 수프에 넣을 당근을 잘게 썰었다.

easy: Able to speak or write easily and clearly, without stopping to search for words.

ex.en: She is fluent in Korean and speaks without stopping to think.
ex.ko: 그녀는 한국어가 유창해서 멈추지 않고 술술 말한다.

easy: A thin, silver musical tube that you blow across to make high sounds.

ex.en: My sister plays the flute in the school band.
ex.ko: 우리 언니는 학교 밴드에서 플루트를 분다.

easy: The mark that your foot or shoe leaves on the ground.

ex.en: We followed the dog's footprints in the snow.
ex.ko: 우리는 눈 위의 강아지 발자국을 따라갔다.

easy: The leading place, where new and important things happen first.

ex.en: Our school is at the forefront of using new computers.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 새로운 컴퓨터를 사용하는 데 앞장서고 있다.

easy: To turn from soft into stiff and solid.

ex.en: The glue hardened overnight.
ex.ko: 풀이 밤새 단단하게 굳었다.

easy: To make something stiff and solid.

ex.en: The cold air hardened the mud on the road.
ex.ko: 차가운 공기가 길의 진흙을 단단하게 굳혔다.

easy: So bad or unkind that people hate it.

ex.en: Calling someone names is a hateful thing to do.
ex.ko: 남에게 욕을 하는 것은 아주 못된 짓이다.

easy: A sickness where the liver is swollen and hurt, often caused by a germ.

ex.en: The doctor explained that hepatitis is a sickness of the liver.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님은 간염이 간의 병이라고 설명해 주셨다.

easy: Having people or animals living there.

ex.en: Only a few of the islands are inhabited.
ex.ko: 그 섬들 중 몇 개만 사람이 산다.

easy: Very strongly or very much.

ex.en: The sun shone intensely on the hot sand.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 모래 위로 햇볕이 강렬하게 내리쬐었다.

easy: A person who pays close attention when someone talks.

ex.en: My best friend is a good listener.
ex.ko: 내 가장 친한 친구는 잘 들어주는 사람이다.

easy: A small tree that grows sweet orange fruit with loose skin that peels off easily.

ex.en: We picked ripe fruit from the mandarin tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 귤나무에서 잘 익은 귤을 땄다.

easy: A tall pole on a boat that holds up the sails.

ex.en: The sailor climbed up the mast to look for land.
ex.ko: 선원은 땅을 찾으려고 돛대 위로 올라갔다.

easy: Not very good and not very bad; just so-so.

ex.en: The pizza was mediocre, not as good as last time.
ex.ko: 그 피자는 그저 그랬고, 지난번만큼 맛있지 않았다.

easy: A way to send messages using short and long signals for each letter.

ex.en: Grandpa taught me how to tap my name in Morse code.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 모스 부호로 내 이름을 두드리는 법을 가르쳐 주셨다.

easy: Wrapped up or put in a box or bag so it can be sold.

ex.en: I like packaged snacks in my lunch box.
ex.ko: 나는 도시락 통에 포장된 과자를 넣는 게 좋다.

easy: A very small amount of money.

ex.en: My allowance is peanuts next to my big brother's.
ex.ko: 내 용돈은 형 용돈에 비하면 푼돈이다.

easy: Lots of energy and a happy, lively feeling.

ex.en: The cheerleaders had so much pep at the game.
ex.ko: 치어리더들은 경기에서 활기가 넘쳤다.

easy: To do something again and again to get better at it.

ex.en: We practise our play every day after school.
ex.ko: 우리는 방과 후에 매일 연극을 연습한다.

easy: To work in a job such as a doctor or a lawyer.

ex.en: My aunt practices medicine as a children's doctor.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 어린이 의사로 일하신다.

easy: A long, loose piece of clothing.

ex.en: After my bath I put on a soft robe.
ex.ko: 목욕 후에 나는 부드러운 가운을 입었다.

easy: A long flowing dress that people wear on special days, like graduation.

ex.en: The graduates wore black robes.
ex.ko: 졸업생들은 검은 가운을 입었다.

easy: The grain from a grass plant that is used to make dark bread.

ex.en: This dark bread is made from rye.
ex.ko: 이 검은 빵은 호밀로 만든다.

easy: A grass plant that farmers grow for its grain.

ex.en: Rye grows tall in the farmer's field.
ex.ko: 호밀은 농부의 밭에서 키 크게 자란다.

easy: Tricky and not honest, doing things in a hidden way to fool people.

ex.en: Peeking at the answers is a sneaky way to win.
ex.ko: 답을 몰래 훔쳐보는 것은 이기려는 치사한 방법이다.

easy: Quiet and careful so that nobody sees you.

ex.en: The sneaky cat crept toward the fish bowl.
ex.ko: 살금살금 다가온 고양이가 어항 쪽으로 기어갔다.

easy: A hole where you push something in, like a plug or a light bulb.

ex.en: I put the plug into the socket.
ex.ko: 나는 플러그를 소켓에 꽂았다.

easy: Being very hungry for a very long time because there is not enough food.

ex.en: Many animals face starvation in a long, cold winter.
ex.ko: 길고 추운 겨울에 많은 동물이 굶주림에 직면한다.

easy: To die because you have no food.

ex.en: Without food, the little bird could starve.
ex.ko: 먹이가 없으면 작은 새는 굶어 죽을 수 있다.

easy: A small seat with no back and no arms.

ex.en: I stand on a stool to reach the top shelf.
ex.ko: 나는 높은 선반에 닿으려고 스툴 위에 올라선다.

easy: To put your foot down on something and walk.

ex.en: Please tread softly because the baby is sleeping.
ex.ko: 아기가 자고 있으니 조용히 걸어 주세요.

easy: To walk with heavy, loud steps.

ex.en: The big boy trod heavily down the stairs.
ex.ko: 덩치 큰 소년이 쿵쿵거리며 계단을 내려갔다.

easy: An agreement to stop fighting for a while.

ex.en: The two friends called a truce and stopped arguing.
ex.ko: 두 친구는 휴전하기로 하고 말다툼을 멈췄다.

easy: A time when everything is mixed up, noisy, and out of control.

ex.en: The classroom was in turmoil when the lights went out.
ex.ko: 불이 꺼지자 교실은 혼란에 빠졌다.

easy: A strong feeling of being upset and confused.

ex.en: My mind was in turmoil before the big test.
ex.ko: 큰 시험 전에 내 마음은 혼란스러웠다.

easy: Not good enough for a job or a purpose.

ex.en: The muddy field was unfit for the soccer game.
ex.ko: 진흙투성이 운동장은 축구 경기에 적합하지 않았다.

easy: Not strong or healthy because you do not exercise.
ko: 건강하지 못한, 몸 상태가 안 좋은

ex.en: After a lazy summer, I felt unfit and got tired quickly.
ex.ko: 게으른 여름을 보낸 뒤 나는 몸 상태가 나빠서 금방 지쳤다.

easy: To stand up for something and keep it safe.

ex.en: Our teacher upholds the rules of the classroom.
ex.ko: 우리 선생님은 교실 규칙을 지키도록 하신다.

easy: A low wall built across a river to slow down or hold back the water.

ex.en: Fish jumped over the weir in the river.
ex.ko: 물고기들이 강의 보를 뛰어넘었다.

easy: A place that is so beautiful that it feels like magic.

ex.en: The snowy park looked like a winter wonderland.
ex.ko: 눈 덮인 공원은 겨울 신비의 나라처럼 보였다.

easy: A make-believe world full of amazing things.

ex.en: Alice fell down a hole and landed in a wonderland.
ex.ko: 앨리스는 구멍 속으로 떨어져 환상의 나라에 도착했다.

easy: An athlete who holds and pushes another person, trying to bring them down onto the mat.

ex.en: My uncle was a wrestler in high school.
ex.ko: 우리 삼촌은 고등학교 때 레슬링 선수였다.

easy: Knowing someone or something a little.

ex.en: I am acquainted with the new girl next door, but we are not close.
ex.ko: 나는 옆집의 새로 온 여자아이를 알지만 친하지는 않다.

easy: Acting fancy to make people think you are better than they are.

ex.en: She put on airs and bragged about her new shoes.
ex.ko: 그녀는 잘난 체하며 새 신발을 자랑했다.

easy: With your voice so others can hear, not quietly in your head.

ex.en: Our teacher asked me to read the story aloud.
ex.ko: 선생님은 내게 이야기를 소리 내어 읽어 보라고 하셨다.

easy: Having sharp corners and straight edges.

ex.en: The toy robot had an angular face with square corners.
ex.ko: 그 장난감 로봇은 네모난 모서리가 있는 각진 얼굴이었다.

easy: Extra pages at the back of a book with more information.

ex.en: The map is in the appendix at the end of the book.
ex.ko: 지도는 책 끝의 부록에 있다.

easy: A small tube-shaped part inside your belly.

ex.en: The doctor took out Dad's appendix.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님이 아빠의 맹장을 떼어 내셨다.

easy: The big room in a school or theater where people sit to watch a show.

ex.en: The whole school gathered in the auditorium for the play.
ex.ko: 전교생이 연극을 보러 강당에 모였다.

easy: Not dangerous to your health and not getting worse.

ex.en: The doctor said the lump was benign, so it was safe.
ex.ko: 의사 선생님은 혹이 양성이라 안전하다고 말씀하셨다.

easy: Kind and gentle, and good for other people.

ex.en: Grandpa gave us a benign smile.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 우리에게 온화한 미소를 지으셨다.

easy: A strong liquid that takes color out of cloth and makes it white.

ex.en: Mom uses bleach to clean the white towels.
ex.ko: 엄마는 하얀 수건을 깨끗하게 하려고 표백제를 쓰신다.

easy: The very edge of a high place.

ex.en: We stood on the brink of the cliff and looked down.
ex.ko: 우리는 절벽 끝에 서서 아래를 내려다보았다.

easy: A shape made by cutting away wood, stone, or other hard stuff.

ex.en: Grandpa made a wooden carving of an owl.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 나무로 부엉이 조각품을 만드셨다.

easy: Cutting hard stuff such as wood to make a shape or pattern.

ex.en: Carving a pumpkin is fun at Halloween.
ex.ko: 할로윈에 호박을 조각하는 것은 재미있다.

easy: Bold and rude, saying things you should not say to others.

ex.en: The cheeky boy stuck out his tongue at the teacher.
ex.ko: 건방진 아이가 선생님께 혀를 내밀었다.

easy: A scientist who studies what things are made of and how they change.

ex.en: The chemist mixed two liquids in a test tube.
ex.ko: 화학자가 시험관에 두 가지 액체를 섞었다.

easy: A person who prepares and gives out medicine.

ex.en: The chemist handed Mom my cough medicine.
ex.ko: 약사가 엄마에게 내 기침약을 건네주었다.

easy: The line where the land meets the sea.

ex.en: We hiked along the rocky coastline.
ex.ko: 우리는 바위투성이 해안선을 따라 걸었다.

easy: A poisonous snake that spreads out the skin of its neck like a hood.

ex.en: The cobra raised its head and spread its hood.
ex.ko: 코브라가 머리를 들고 목 주름을 펼쳤다.

easy: A garden plant with bright, thin-petaled flowers that bloom in the fall.

ex.en: Pink cosmos flowers waved in the autumn wind.
ex.ko: 분홍색 코스모스가 가을바람에 흔들렸다.

easy: To lock someone's hands together with metal rings.

ex.en: The officer cuffed the robber.
ex.ko: 경찰관이 강도에게 수갑을 채웠다.

easy: Having hair that bends into little rings.

ex.en: My little sister has soft, curling hair.
ex.ko: 내 여동생은 부드러운 곱슬머리다.

easy: A game on ice where players slide heavy stones toward a target.

ex.en: We watched curling on TV during the Winter Olympics.
ex.ko: 우리는 겨울 올림픽 때 텔레비전으로 컬링을 봤다.

easy: A big wind that spins around a center where the air pressure is low.

ex.en: The weather reporter said a cyclone was forming over the ocean.
ex.ko: 기상 캐스터는 바다 위에 사이클론이 생기고 있다고 말했다.

easy: A very strong wind that spins round and round.

ex.en: The cyclone tore roofs off the houses.
ex.ko: 사이클론이 집들의 지붕을 날려 버렸다.

easy: To figure out an answer by thinking about facts you know.

ex.en: The detective derived the answer from three clues.
ex.ko: 탐정은 세 가지 단서에서 답을 알아냈다.

easy: To come from a family or people who lived long ago.

ex.en: Many Americans are descended from people who came by ship.
ex.ko: 많은 미국인은 배를 타고 온 사람들의 후손이다.

easy: Moving from a high place to a lower place.

ex.en: The descending plane got bigger as it came near the runway.
ex.ko: 내려오는 비행기는 활주로에 가까워질수록 커 보였다.

easy: Paying careful attention to your work and doing it with care.

ex.en: She checked her homework with great diligence.
ex.ko: 그녀는 아주 성실하게 숙제를 확인했다.

easy: Working hard and not giving up on a job.

ex.en: Her diligence paid off when she won the spelling bee.
ex.ko: 그녀의 부지런함은 철자 대회에서 우승하면서 결실을 맺었다.

easy: Following the rules and behaving well.

ex.en: The disciplined class lined up quietly.
ex.ko: 규율을 잘 지키는 반은 조용히 줄을 섰다.

easy: Made strong or skilled by lots of practice.

ex.en: The disciplined gymnast trained every day.
ex.ko: 단련된 체조 선수는 매일 훈련했다.

easy: To see how two things are different from each other.

ex.en: It is hard to discriminate between the twins.
ex.ko: 쌍둥이를 구별하기는 어렵다.

easy: To treat people in an unfair way because of who they are.

ex.en: It is wrong to discriminate against someone because of skin color.
ex.ko: 피부색 때문에 누군가를 차별하는 것은 잘못이다.

easy: A change of direction away from your path.

ex.en: We took a diversion because the road was closed.
ex.ko: 길이 막혀서 우리는 우회했다.

easy: A big metal box outside where people throw away trash.

ex.en: The workers threw the old boards into the dumpster.
ex.ko: 일꾼들은 낡은 판자를 대형 쓰레기 수거함에 던져 넣었다.

easy: To give someone the right or power to do something.

ex.en: The coach empowered the captain to pick the team.
ex.ko: 코치는 주장에게 팀을 고를 권한을 주었다.

easy: From or about the country of Ethiopia in Africa.

ex.en: We ate Ethiopian food at a restaurant.
ex.ko: 우리는 식당에서 에티오피아 음식을 먹었다.

easy: A person who was born in Ethiopia or lives there.

ex.en: An Ethiopian runner won the race.
ex.ko: 에티오피아 선수가 달리기 경주에서 우승했다.
